output_text:
{
  "score": 8,
  "flaws": [
    "Floating catch-lid over the cup: In the close-up view, the yellow and brown rectangular blocks resting above the white cup are completely disconnected and floating in mid-air without any physical attachment to the backstop posts or the cup rim.",
    "Geometry clipping and awkward overhang at the cup entrance: The lower end of the light-wood ramp clips directly into the yellow floating frame and the rim of the white cup, rather than terminating cleanly above it with a proper bracket.",
    "Unrealistic scale and overhang of the upper ramp: As seen in the top and overview cameras, the first track section extends way past the back-left edge of the desk, making it look less like a self-contained desk toy and more like an oversized structure.",
    "Crude central transition block: The brown deflector wall and spoked wheel at the junction between the two ramps intersect clumsily with the track walls, lacking clean joinery or mechanical logic for why the wheel is mounted there.",
    "Flat, unpolished materials on the tracks and desk: While the brass accents have nice specular highlights, the wooden ramps, baseboard, and desk surface have flat, matte shaders with zero wood grain or surface texture."
  ],
  "summary": "The marble run achieves a perfect 16/16 reliability score and features nice brass and dark-metal styling on the support pillars, along with charming desk props. However, it falls short of a 9+ polish level due to floating geometry above the target cup, clipping at the ramp-to-cup transition, flat wood shaders, and the upper track awkwardly overhanging the desk edge."
}

flaws: Floating catch-lid over the cup: In the close-up view, the yellow and brown rectangular blocks resting above the white cup are completely disconnected and floating in mid-air without any physical attachment to the backstop posts or the cup rim.

Geometry clipping and awkward overhang at the cup entrance: The lower end of the light-wood ramp clips directly into the yellow floating frame and the rim of the white cup, rather than terminating cleanly above it with a proper bracket.

Unrealistic scale and overhang of the upper ramp: As seen in the top and overview cameras, the first track section extends way past the back-left edge of the desk, making it look less like a self-contained desk toy and more like an oversized structure.

Crude central transition block: The brown deflector wall and spoked wheel at the junction between the two ramps intersect clumsily with the track walls, lacking clean joinery or mechanical logic for why the wheel is mounted there.

Flat, unpolished materials on the tracks and desk: While the brass accents have nice specular highlights, the wooden ramps, baseboard, and desk surface have flat, matte shaders with zero wood grain or surface texture.
